technical.summary: Strong technical confluence with price above all key MAs and bullish momentum indicators, but overbought conditions (RSI 9: 72, Stoch K: 85) and neutral sector momentum create pullback risk; better suited for profit-taking or waiting for retracement entry.

fundamental.summary: LEN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 42 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with mild greed; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (181), FOMC event in 1 day creates binary risk, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction in recessionary environment despite falling USD tailwind.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with RSI 9 and Stochastic in bullish alignment creates technical confluence for continuation, supported by positive momentum divergence.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 181, FOMC binary event in 1 day), overbought technicals (RSI 72, Stoch K 85), zero fundamental conviction, and Consumer Discretionary sector recession vulnerability overwhelm bullish setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above all major MAs with bullish momentum confluence (RSI 9: 72, Stoch K: 85), but overbought conditions and proximity to resistance severely limit risk/reward at current levels.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis (181), and FOMC event in 1 day create binary macro risk; Consumer Discretionary demand destruction in recession environment directly threatens LEN fundamentals.
decision.recommended_exit: If forced to hold existing position: trailing_15pct to protect against macro shock; otherwise avoid new entry until post-FOMC clarity and technical retracement to MA support.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical overbought, fundamental weak, sentiment neutral, macro severely unfavourable
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding LEN position with 64 existing Consumer Discretionary positions (15% of portfolio); sector concentration and earnings risk within 42 days argue against adding exposure.
